id: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story (2007)

new.note: Shoestring fries under hot brown onion gravy, spring onion on top.
new.how: Crisp shoestring fries under a hot brown onion gravy, the way a 1960s lunch counter served them. Bake 1kg frozen shoestring chips at 220C for 20 minutes. Soften 1 finely sliced onion in 20g butter for 8 minutes, stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, then whisk in 300ml vegetable stock and 1 tsp soy sauce and simmer until thick. Pour over the chips and scatter with sliced spring onion.

r2.make_ahead: Make the gravy up to 2 days ahead and reheat; bake the chips on the night

steps.text: Bake the frozen shoestring chips at 220C until crisp.
Soften the onion in the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Pour the gravy over the chips and scatter with sliced spring onion.
